answer: A concrete approach: force a unique proof-of-place stamp per epoch that cannot be replayed by siblings. Link analysis on reused seeds marks the whole set. Because it works by converting a one-time spend into a recurring per-account bill, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The network ties the nectar to sunk effort, uses the cipher as an corroborating signal, then requires a jade before any payout.
